content.text: How should I title my rental properties for estate planning?

Titling depends on your goals: liability protection, probate avoidance, and tax efficiency. Common approaches include: (1) Revocable trust for probate avoidance, (2) LLC for liability protection, (3) Family Limited Partnership for valuation discounts. Joint tenancy passes automatically but may lose step-up basis benefits. How many properties, and what's your primary concern—liability, probate, or taxes?
Should I do a 1031 exchange or hold for step-up basis?

This depends on your timeline and heirs' plans. 1031 defers capital gains but carries over basis—your heirs inherit the deferred gain. Holding until death provides full step-up to fair market value, eliminating embedded gains. Consider: your age, the property's appreciation, cash flow needs, and whether heirs will keep or sell. What's the approximate built-in gain and your timeline?
